recordStETHYield(uint256).details: Called after EWBDeltaNeutralVault.harvestYield()      stETH already transferred to owner by vault — this      records the income event for accounting purposes

recordStETHYieldAuto(uint256).details: Vault calls this immediately after transferring stETH to safeMultisig,      so income is recorded on-chain without a separate manual multisig call.      Caller must be the registered deltaVault address.

registerTBA(uint256,address,uint256).details: Only for tokens where owner wants yield split to TBA      Treasury tokens (unminted) all route to owner

params.splitBps: Basis points to send to TBA (max 5000 = 50%)
params.tbaAddress: TBA wallet address for this token

routeDyDxIncome(address,uint256).details: dYdX operates off-chain (Cosmos chain) — owner manually      withdraws and routes through this contract for accounting

params.amount: Amount collected from Uniswap V3 position

routeMintingVaultInterest(address,uint25.details: Called by EWBMintingRightsVault.sweepInterestToRouter().      Tokens already transferred to this contract before this call.      Caller must be the registered mintingVault address.

routeToTBA(address,address,uint256).details: FIX H-2: Explicit per-token TBA routing function      Owner calls this per registered TBA token to distribute their share

params.amount: Amount to send to this TBA

getAnnualEstimates().notice: Get estimated annual income across all streams

getTotalIncome().notice: Get total income received across all streams

recordStETHYield(uint256).notice: Route harvested stETH yield to owner

recordStETHYieldAuto(uint256).notice: Auto-record stETH yield — called directly by EWBDeltaNeutralVault

registerTBA(uint256,address,uint256).notice: Register a token's TBA for split income routing

routeDyDxIncome(address,uint256).notice: Route dYdX funding rate income to owner

routeInterest(address,uint256).notice: Route interest income from private pool to owner

routeLPFees(address,uint256).notice: Route collected LP fees to owner

routeMintingVaultInterest(address,uint25.notice: Receive USDC interest swept from EWBMintingRightsVault.

routeToTBA(address,address,uint256).notice: Route income directly to a specific TBA
